message:
## Vulnerability Digest

No confirmed vulnerabilities newly reported in the last 24 hours directly affect the monitored products. One ACF-adjacent finding was retained as a possible match needing deployment review.

Coverage note: the public CVE List and GitHub Advisory Database were checked for the window from 2026-08-01 05:10 IST to 2026-08-02 05:10 IST. General web search was unavailable during this run, so vendor-only notices not yet represented in those feeds may be missing.

### Possible matches needing review

**CVE-2026-15262 — Admin Columns for ACF Fields**

- Product/component: Admin Columns for ACF Fields WordPress plugin, through version 0.3.2
- Severity: Not clearly stated in the CVE record
- Description: The plugin does not escape Advanced Custom Fields values before displaying them in WordPress admin list-table columns, allowing a contributor-level user to store JavaScript that executes when a higher-privileged user views the affected screen.
- Relevance: Advanced Custom Fields is monitored, but the affected product is a separate third-party integration rather than ACF itself. This finding is relevant only if Admin Columns for ACF Fields is installed.
- Sources: [CVE Record](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-15262), [WPScan advisory](https://wpscan.com/vulnerability/dea1f3a9-2681-47a6-9e36-9d6ea799decb/)

No immediate product-wide review is recommended based on confirmed direct matches. Check the WordPress inventory for Admin Columns for ACF Fields; review this item promptly if that plugin is deployed.
